name: Maths Wizard & Spelling Genius - Uttarakhand
benefit: Under this scheme, to enhance the interest of Class 5 students in Mathematics and English, the Government of India organized the “Maths Wizard” and “Spelling Genius” competitions at the school, block, district, and state levels under AWP-B for the year 2023-24, wherein participating students were encouraged through rewards.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a Class 5 student of a government school in Uttarakhand.
